key_insight: This paper builds a large spin-polarized database of halide double perovskites, revealing many stable compounds with visible-range band gaps and a notable subset of half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: The dataset gives materials engineers a searchable starting point for designing perovskite photovoltaics, photocatalysts, radiation detectors, and spintronic materials.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT computed DOS for 2,500+ Cs2BB'X6 compounds.
Applied LOBSTER to analyze chemical bonding and orbital interactions.
Added UMAP visualizations plus an interactive app for composition and property exploration.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports over 2,500 compounds analyzed, including 719 with visible-range band gaps and 118 with half-metallic character.
watch_item: The results are database-driven predictions, so candidate materials still need experimental validation and stability checks beyond the τ-tolerance screening.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
